description_en: This topic describes the syntax and provides examples of the bone mineral density estimation feature (CalcBMD) in the image analysis and processing (imageprocess) category
description_zh: 本文介绍图像分析处理（imageprocess）类目下的骨密度估计CalcBMD的语法及示例
kebab_example: aliyun imageprocess calc-bmd --data-format DICOM --org-name '测试组织' --org-id 7ff51bfe-e73d-11ea-827d-506b4b3f3cf6 --source-type HTTP_FILES --url-list URL=https://medclients-sh.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/demo/xxx/0001.dcm --region cn-hangzhou
name: CalcBMD

parameters.help_en: The format of the image. DICOM and NIFTI are supported
parameters.name: data_format

parameters.help_en: The name of the sub-channel (such as a hospital) under the current channel (the primary account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）名称
parameters.name: org_name

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the sub-channel (such as a hospital) under the current channel (the primary account)
parameters.help_zh: 当前渠道（即主账号）下的子渠道（即机构，如医院）标识
parameters.name: org_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the input data. HTTP_FILES and HTTP_NII are supported.
HTTP_FILES: series files.
HTTP_NII: a single file
parameters.help_zh:
输入数据的类型，支持HTTP_FILES和HTTP_NII。
HTTP_FILES为序列文件。
HTTP_NII为单个文件
parameters.name: source_type

fields.help_en:
The URL list of DICOM series files or NIFTI files ["url","url",......]。
We recommend that you use OSS links in the Shanghai region. If the files are stored locally or in an OSS region other than Shanghai, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

The N in URLList.N.URL indicates the sequence number of the image URL in the current list (starting from 1). When you directly use the API request, specify the URLList parameters in the format of URLList.1.URL=url1, URLList.2.URL=url2, and so on. Connect parameter pairs with ampersands (&). Replace url1, url2, and other values with actual values. When you use an SDK to populate URLList, use the corresponding methods provided by the SDK
fields.help_zh:
DICOM序列文件URL列表或NIFTI文件URL列表["url","url",......]。
推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

URLList.N.URL中的N为该图像URL在当前List中的顺序（从1开始）。当直接使用API请求时，输入URLList的填充会以URLList.1.URL=url1，URLList.2.URL=url2，......的方式指定参数和参数值，参数对以&连接，其中url1、url2、......等具体值请根据实际情况进行替换；当使用SDK填充URLList时，可直接使用SDK提供的相应的方法
fields.name: url
